work_completed: Implemented FUNCTIONS/otoiLoader.ts: loads and validates one TOI per session agent, enforces cross-agent rules (known roles, singular-role uniqueness, required roles, escalation-path resolution), emits a session-level OTOI contract.
Extracted shared FUNCTIONS/roleRegistry.ts (role map, KNOWN_ROLES, SINGULAR_ROLES, REQUIRED_ROLES) and FUNCTIONS/loadTOI.ts (loadTOIForRole); refactored attachTOIOnAgentJoin.ts to use them.
Generalized the canonical schema path in FUNCTIONS/validateTOI.ts to resolve relative to the module with a process.cwd() fallback.
Synced SCHEMAS/toi.schema.json to the canonical @neurolift-technologies/toi v1.0.0 schema and aligned SCHEMAS/otoi.schema.json with the loader's session contract output.
Added TESTS/otoi_loader.test.ts (9 tests) covering cross-agent rules, session building, escalation resolution, and OTOI schema conformance.
Updated README.md, docs/active-threads.md; added agent registration and intent log records.
Verified: 12/12 tests pass, tsc --noEmit clean, governance validation 37/37 strict pass.
decisions_made: Escalation-path rule treats references that do not resolve to a known role as external escalation targets; only references to known in-session roles that are absent are flagged (matches real TOI data, e.g. /research_lead).
OTOI schema conformance is asserted via test rather than wired into the loader, since the loader constructs conformant documents by construction.
SCHEMAS/toi.schema.json is now a byte-copy of the canonical package schema.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Review the PR on branch feat/otoi-loader-and-schema-sync. Verify npm test (12 passing), npx tsc --noEmit, and bash .nltotoi/scripts/validate-governance.sh --strict. Note issue PAIR-code/deliberate-lab#606 is still open and relevant.
